CPD: an-upanisa , mfn. ( a ) ( cf . upanisā in the sense of upanissaya, i. e. paccaya), unconditioned; SN ll 30, 2 foll. ( opp. sa-upanisa, see Spk ll 53, 19 ); — (b) ( cf . śraddhayā upaniṣadā, Chāndogya-up. l 1,jo), not attentive ( to a guru); AN l 198, 26-27 (an-ohita- soto . . . ~o hoti); cf . Sn 322 & AN lV 391, 13 .
NCP: mfn. lacking attention, inattentive. without a cause, without prerequisite See also: upanisa
